schedule: Separately planned 16-writer follow-up after every initial 16-writer sample was flagged: one warmup and two scored runs per arm with balanced alternating order, 30 seconds initial cooldown and five seconds between invocations. No score-selected replacement runs.
ranking: Highest eligible throughput per exact binary and workload within this follow-up; p99 and counts come from the same invocation. Keep the initial cohort separately.

stall_filter.selection: Flag each run using mean times; passing means can still hide brief SSD stalls.

constraints: Baseline is the exact previously measured dynamic grouping binary.
Candidate derives the large-wave hint from all ticket DATA buffer sizes; it changes no DATA grouping, new wait window, wire format or sync protocol.
All scratch databases remain inside the local repository.
Do not qualify a performance win from stalled or insufficient samples.
